about_the_game:
The Algian Sword is a narrative-driven RPG where your choices shape a world full of consequences, with a strategic turnbased combat with real time elements. 

Features

  • Non-linear story with deep choices and evolving characters. 

  • Two Main characters to choose from: Ross, the Captain of the guard and Nym, the seer aprentice. Each path will have unique scenarios allowing the character to evolve, and change the outcome on the scenarios common to both

  • Psicological traits system: choices will earn the main character traits, changing how they behave and react, opening new options

  • Time Units: Certain actions will consume time units, advancing the day and changing NPC behavior and advancing the story

  • Cinematic camera system and original soundtrack for an immersive experience.

  • Hybrid combat: real-time strategy meets turn-based mechanics.

  • Players must study the enemies and choose up to 3 actions, between offensive and defensive options. 

  • Change between weapons to change your playstyle: switch between wepons mid combat to adapt your strategy

  • Distinct art style: 3D environments + 2D pixel art characters.

  • Visually rich and cohesive world design.

content_descriptors.notes: You may find people drinking at a tabern, an interrogation can go wrong and end up in a beatdown(pixel art, not extremely explicit)

  • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 3 1200 / Intel® Core™ i3-6100
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon™ RX 460 / NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 750
  • DirectX: Version 12

  • Additional Notes: 60 FPS @ 1280x720, Preset "Low", 2GB VRAM required
